raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 17
Reason for Mistake: At this step, WebSurfer began collecting Rotten Tomatoes ratings for an incomplete and misidentified set of Ted Danson multi-season series—omitting “CSI: Cyber” (where Danson was a series regular in season 2) and instead focusing on “CSI: Crime Scene Investigation.” This omission of “CSI: Cyber” from consideration led the analysis down the wrong path and prevented selecting the correct worst-rated series available on Amazon Prime Video (US). Subsequent steps compounded the issue, but the first causal error occurred here.
